name: The Romantic Era: A Classical Otome Game
source:
It’s 1832, and you’re a rising young pianist in France. After a chance encounter with composer Franz Liszt, you find yourself thrown headfirst into the scene of Parisian virtuoso instrumentalists and composers.

[From [url=https://tritonestudios.itch.io/the-romantic-era]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
1832年，你是法国一位冉冉升起的年轻钢琴家。在与作曲家弗朗茨·李斯特的偶然邂逅后，你会发现自己一头扎进了巴黎演奏家和作曲家的舞台。

[来自[url=https://tritonestudios.itch.io/the-romantic-era]itch.io[/url]]
